name: Knave of Hearts

performer_basis.rule: SUP-002 + SUP-004: human performer, card-coded as a flat Jack-of-Hearts figure; FAC-house-of-hearts livery (emblem_visual: crimson coat/tabard piped cream, red heart badge, stylised Jack device)

gender_note.quote: The Knave shook his head sadly. “Do I look like it?” he said.

hair.style: shoulder-length, evenly rolled under at the ends in the face-card Jack manner, centre-parted, worn under a flat black cap
hair.reason: Source gives no hair; the rolled shoulder-length coif of the English-pattern Jack face card makes the card reading legible on a human performer (SUP-004).

eyes.expression: sidelong, watchful, quick to lower in a bow
eyes.reason: Not described; hazel sits naturally with chestnut hair for an English performer; the sidelong look follows his answering the Queen only with a bow and smile (ch008-p13).

skin.tone: fair English complexion, lightly flushed at the cheeks
skin.reason: Not described; fits a young English courtier-page and the face-card's rosy cheeks.

face.quote: the Knave of Hearts, who only bowed and smiled in reply
face.reason: Only the bow-and-smile is in the source; moustache taken from the Jack face-card convention.

build.posture: rigidly frontal and flat — turns the whole torso rather than the neck, like a card being turned
build.reason: Flatness is sourced; height designed to read as a young man of the court, taller than the gardeners' card figures.

scale_reference.in_scene: On screen he is always a grown man over Alice at her normal height (about 135-140 cm, a ten-year-old); at the trial Alice grows past everyone (ch012) so late shots show him shrinking relative to her — handled by SUP-003 forced perspective, not by a different performer.
scale_reference.reason: Alice's height is designed on her own card; relative scale follows SUP-003.

base_age_source.reason: Source gives no age; 'knave' (a page/servant) and his role carrying the crown point to a young man of the household rather than a youth or elder.

default_outfit_tone: crimson and cream Hearts livery worn as a flat Jack-of-Hearts card: stiff card-tabard front and back over an 1862 footman's cut-away coat, knee breeches, white stockings

default_outfit_tone_source.quote: Then followed the Knave of Hearts, carrying the King’s crown on a crimson velvet cushion
default_outfit_tone_source.reason: Colours and livery cut follow FAC-house-of-hearts emblem_visual; the card-tabard is the SUP-004 flat-card reading. Full costume design belongs to 06-art/costume.

period_silhouette_1862.silhouette: upright rectangle: the stiff tabard flattens the torso into a card outline from shoulders to mid-thigh; below it slim breeches, white stockings, low black buckled shoes
period_silhouette_1862.reason: 1860s household livery base with the card shape laid over it per SUP-004.

touches: flat card-tabard with a single large red heart and a stylised Jack device at the breast
rolled Jack coif and thin moustache
sup002_coding.restraint: No painted-paper skin, no cardboard prosthetic on the face; the face stays a real human face.

marks.item: stylised Jack device beside a red heart badge at the breast of the tabard
marks.reason: FAC-house-of-hearts emblem_visual assigns the Knave a Jack device.

marks.item: iron chains at the wrists, a soldier either side
marks.quote: the Knave was standing before them, in chains, with a soldier on each side to guard him

signature_items.item: the King's crown carried on a crimson velvet cushion

prompt_base_en: a slim young English man of about 27, chestnut shoulder-length hair rolled under at the ends beneath a small flat black cap, thin trimmed moustache, hazel eyes, fair skin, a close-lipped courtier's smile, wearing a stiff flat crimson-and-cream card tabard with a large red heart and a Jack device over an 1862 footman's cut-away coat, knee breeches and white stockings, standing rigidly frontal like a playing card
